fullContentHtml:
MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post. This recruitment was released for 1700 posts. Applications for the MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Recruitment 2026 has Started from 29 August 2026, & Candidate can apply till 12 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 August 2026
  • Last Date : 12 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 12 September 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 17September 2026
  • Exam Date : 07 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 560/-
  • OBC, SC, ST : Rs. 310/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 310/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Portal Charges Extra : Rs. 60/- (Include)
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Online Form 2026?

MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 12 September 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://esb.mp.gov.in/e_default.html

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
